answer: Make new agents earn voting weight through a time-locked stake that vests only after peers from separate funding lineages confirm their work. A sybil farm can mint a thousand keys, but each one sits like a willow sapling with shallow roots until it survives several epochs of review. If graders spot a shared cipher in prose style or a common wallet source, the whole cluster's stake drops into a canyon of slashing, so cloning becomes a losing bet.
